notes: The description says the deck went 2-2 at the Atlanta DPC (27-4 overall record).
Format Premiere - Tatooine: the list has no Coruscant-set card and the Atlanta DPC (28 July 2001) was played before Coruscant was tournament legal.

Posted 'starting6 [8 with other two effects]': SYC, Death Star, Death Star DB, Alderaan, Prepped defenses and A Million Voices, plus two '[effect varies]' lines. The section headers add up to 60 only with a starting count of 6, so the two varying starting Effects are taken from the Effects section (the strategy says to start Mobilization Points against some decks); the '[effect varies]' lines are not counted as extra cards.
The posted list totals 59: the 'Ships11' header lists only 10 starships (8 named plus TIE Interceptors x2). Kept as published.

Posted 'Captain Godherdt (may be replaced by ghhhk/TRWEU)': counted as Captain Godherdt; Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us is an alternative and is not counted (the Characters12 section has 12 cards with Godherdt).

Posted 'SYC' dested Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe; 'Death Star DB' and 'Alderaan' the Dark Premiere pages; 'hoth', 'endor', 'tatooine' the Dark system pages (Hoth (Dark), Endor (Dark), Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere)).

Posted 'dark path' dested The Dark Path (Dagobah); the strategy describes its game text. 'evader/monok' dested Evader & Monnok; 'zuckuss in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Vader with Saber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'twilek adviser' Twi'lek Advisor; 'SFS 9.3 LS Cannons' SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons.
Come Here You Big Coward, Secret Plans and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement are the Effect printings (Defensive Shields came later).
